children.nl_statement: The one-variable coefficient, local surplus and derivative certificates of Lemma 4.1 hold on [-6,10], together with the four logarithmic endpoint gaps used in Section 4.2.
children.role_in_glue: Supplies the certificate on the central interval and all fixed logarithmic gaps.

children.nl_statement: The coefficient, local surplus and derivative certificates of Lemma 4.1 hold on the full negative tail a<=-6.
children.role_in_glue: Supplies the certificate below the central interval, using negative Gaussian excess-moment asymptotics.

children.nl_statement: The coefficient, local surplus and derivative certificates of Lemma 4.1 hold on the full positive tail a>=10.
children.role_in_glue: Supplies the certificate above the central interval, using the positive-tail logarithmic correction to k.

children.nl_statement: For arbitrary smooth k and positive continuous q, positivity of p and the scalar two-endpoint estimate imply the integrated matrix residual bound for any smooth bounded symmetric A and any constant symmetric family X.
children.role_in_glue: Lifts the scalar estimate through matrix CFC derivatives, transposed-entry pairing, basis invariance, and integration; instantiated with X_r=E[x_r A].

notes: Five independent conditional interfaces: compact/left/right certificates, a secant deduction with the certificates as explicit hypotheses, and a generic CFC/integration bridge with the scalar pair inequality as an explicit hypothesis. The latter two can be proved without waiting for certificate proofs. No transport or entropy conclusion is placed in these children.
